content.summary: For investors looking to position for continued weakness in oil prices, one potential strategy is a bear call spread using the United States Oil Fund exchange traded note.  Oil prices moved sharply higher in early Monday trading as tensions between the U.S. and Venezuela escalated, with the U.S. intensifying its blockade of the Maduro-led government.  Over the longer term, oil prices continue to face significant headwinds.
